name: introductions
purpose: One durable record per attempted introduction, retained after completion, decline, expiry, cancellation, or archival. A deliberate restart creates a new ID linked to its predecessor.

columns.name: owner_user_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES users.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
columns.meaning: Sender and history owner; never accepted from request body.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.meaning: Source scope when applicable; not a grant of shared history access.

columns.name: source_batch_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES suggestions.suggestion_batch(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
columns.meaning: Live source link; snapshot survives source removal.

columns.name: source_suggestion_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES suggestions.suggestion(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
columns.meaning: Live source link; source tuple is checked by the source reader.

columns.name: source_key
columns.meaning: Immutable canonical batch/suggestion/action identity for duplicate-open handling.

columns.name: source_snapshot
columns.meaning: Original IDs, title, source metadata and raw WHY; immutable, owner-private.

columns.name: previous_introduction_id
columns.meaning: Intentional new attempt after a prior closed sequence.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: Go-validated lifecycle: draft, first_queued, awaiting_first, second_queued, awaiting_second, introduction_queued, introducing, introduced, declined, cancelled, expired, failed.

columns.name: revision
columns.meaning: Optimistic concurrency counter for every owner-visible mutation.

columns.name: current_context_version_id
columns.meaning: Current owner-reviewed working context; composite FK added after context table exists.

columns.name: launch_context_version_id
columns.meaning: Frozen context at start, immutable afterward.

columns.name: current_stage
columns.meaning: Furthest stage reached: draft, first_request, second_request, or final_introduction. Frozen at terminal closure so history keeps where the sequence stopped; the Closed filter reads state/closed_at, not this column.

columns.name: dispatch_blocked_at
columns.meaning: Time the hold set became non-empty; cleared when the last hold clears. Stage and past consent remain unchanged.

columns.name: dispatch_holds
columns.meaning: Set of active dispatch holds, each `{cause, detail, set_at, set_by, optional delivery_id/participant_id evidence}`. Cause vocabulary: recipient_suppressed, permanent_delivery_failure, sender_ineligible, source_access_revoked, template_unavailable, unresolved_send. Multiple causes may be active; clearing one must not clear another. Mutated only under the introduction lock; every set/clear also writes an event. Durable evidence stays in events/delivery records.

columns.name: stream_seq
columns.meaning: Per-introduction durable SSE sequence allocated under this row lock.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Creation time, including drafts that never launch.

columns.name: closed_at
columns.meaning: Terminal workflow milestone; preserve historical events.

columns.name: archived_at
columns.meaning: Hide from default history, never delete correspondence.

columns.name: active_source_key
columns.meaning: Set to source_key while active, cleared at terminal closure; enables deliberate restarts.

indexes: CREATE INDEX introductions_owner_history_idx ON warm_intros.introductions(owner_user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX introductions_owner_state_idx ON warm_intros.introductions(owner_user_id, state, created_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX introductions_active_source_uq ON warm_intros.introductions(owner_user_id, active_source_key) WHERE active_source_key IS NOT NULL
constraints: UNIQUE (id, owner_user_id)
FOREIGN KEY (previous_introduction_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id, owner_user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
post_create_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id, launch_context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: participants
purpose: Two stable identities per introduction. Live links can disappear without losing the historical identity. The email/name/role actually approved for sending belongs in the context snapshot.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: contact_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES persons.contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
columns.meaning: Live sender-owned contact; authorize at creation and launch.

columns.name: person_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES persons.persons(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: original_person_id
columns.meaning: Immutable original identity even after merges/deletion.

columns.name: source_role
columns.meaning: beneficiary or suggested; independent of selected send order.

columns.name: identity_snapshot
columns.meaning: Original full name and source identifiers; supports historical labels.

constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
UNIQUE (introduction_id, original_person_id)
UNIQUE (introduction_id, source_role)

name: context_versions
purpose: Append-only WHY, sender intent, profile, address, and order history. Every message review, consent, and send can resolve the exact context used at that point.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: source_why
columns.meaning: Exact source suggestion.why object: headline plus ordered body[] paragraphs; preserve strings and boundaries without summarizing or flattening.

columns.name: why_connect
columns.meaning: Working WHY object with the same headline/body[] shape; initially a deep copy of source_why, with every edit versioned.

columns.name: sender_intent
columns.meaning: Separate natural-language explanation of what the sender wants to accomplish; nullable if not supplied.

columns.name: why_status
columns.meaning: present, partially_present, or not_provided; never fabricate missing rationale.

columns.name: why_provenance
columns.meaning: For each text: source type, source ID/version, authored_by and captured_at; retain original and edited provenance.

columns.name: private_context
columns.meaning: Additional owner-private suggestion reasoning; never public DTO content.

columns.name: recipient_safe_facts
columns.meaning: Allowlisted facts usable in recipient copy; distinct from private context.

columns.name: public_why
columns.meaning: Optional sender-approved headline/body[] explanation for recipient copy; no automatic publication of the full working WHY.

columns.name: sender_snapshot
columns.meaning: Display name, verified reply address, signature policy and the approved signature content at this version; post-launch profile edits cannot change frozen copy.

columns.name: presentation_snapshot
columns.meaning: Versioned manifest of all four HTML/text assets, public copy/disclosures, sender envelope/signature, and policy values; immutable content hashes/references retained for the lifetime of the sequence.

columns.name: participant_snapshots
columns.meaning: Exactly two keyed objects: participant ID, name, title/company, selected address/address source, safe profile and selected position.

columns.name: first_participant_id
columns.meaning: First execution recipient for this version.

columns.name: second_participant_id
columns.meaning: Second execution recipient for this version.

columns.name: recommended_first_participant_id
columns.meaning: Recommendation kept independently from selected order.

columns.name: relationship_evidence
columns.meaning: Private comparable weight/evidence source and as-of time; no public exposure.

columns.name: change_reason
columns.meaning: source_loaded, why_edited (covers sender_intent and public_why edits), address_changed, order_changed, profile_changed, sender_changed, or presentation_changed.

columns.name: created_by_user_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES users.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
columns.meaning: Editor identity; nullable for system capture.

constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
UNIQUE (introduction_id, version)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, first_participant_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.participants(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, second_participant_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.participants(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, recommended_first_participant_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.participants(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: messages
purpose: Stable logical message slots: two requests and one final introduction. Neutral closure slots are created only when applicable. Reordering never changes a request’s participant.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: participant_id
columns.meaning: Request/closure recipient; null for shared final introduction.

columns.name: current_version_id
columns.meaning: Current saved text version; composite FK added after versions exist.

columns.name: approved_version_id
columns.meaning: Frozen launch-approved version; immutable after start.

columns.name: active_generation_run_id
columns.meaning: Generation allowed to replace current text; stale runs cannot write through this pointer.

columns.name: generation_status
columns.meaning: idle, queued, streaming, ready, failed, or cancelled.

constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (introduction_id, kind, participant_id)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, participant_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.participants(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
post_create_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (id, current_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.message_versions(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id, approved_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.message_versions(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id, active_generation_run_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.generation_runs(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: message_versions
purpose: Append-only saved draft and sent-message content. Each completed AI result or debounced human save produces a new version; keep all server-accepted versions, not every keystroke.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: subject
columns.meaning: Exact saved subject, limit 160 Unicode characters in service.

columns.name: body
columns.meaning: Exact plain-text note including paragraphs, greeting and sign-off; limit 3000 Unicode characters.

columns.name: content_sha256
columns.meaning: Hash of canonical subject/body, never a substitute for stored text.

columns.name: author_user_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES users.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
UNIQUE (message_id, id)
UNIQUE (message_id, version)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
post_create_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (message_id, supersedes_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.message_versions(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (message_id, generation_run_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.generation_runs(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: reviews
purpose: Append-only sender approval receipts. A review is current only when its message version and approval dependency hash match the current draft. Invalidation does not delete prior reviews.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: context_version_id
columns.meaning: Exact context viewed when approving; provenance is retained even if an unrelated address later changes.

columns.name: approval_scope_sha256
columns.meaning: Canonical hash of this message text and its relevant people/order/WHY/address/sender dependencies. Start recomputes and compares it.

columns.name: reviewed_by_user_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES users.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints: UNIQUE (message_id, message_version_id, context_version_id)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (message_id, message_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.message_versions(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: invitations
purpose: Recipient-specific capability tied to one frozen invitation. Create the second invitation only after the first acceptance applies. No account is needed to resolve it.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: message_id
columns.meaning: Approved request slot; version supplied through frozen slot.

columns.name: public_snapshot
columns.meaning: Frozen allowlisted public view: profile, reviewed note/signature, truthful stage banner and exact consent disclosure. No capability or email addresses. Store before dispatch; server decides allowed actions separately.

columns.name: token_hash
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of a random 256-bit token; no plaintext token column.

columns.name: token_version
columns.meaning: Bind requests to this capability version; the public API exposes it as token_version on resolve/decision.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: queued, active, decided, expired, or revoked.

columns.name: first_send_attempt_at
columns.meaning: Deadline starts when the immutable send payload is first frozen for dispatch.

columns.name: expires_at
columns.meaning: Exact deadline frozen before first attempt; set with payload in one transaction.

indexes: CREATE INDEX invitations_expiry_idx ON warm_intros.invitations(expires_at, id) WHERE state IN ('queued', 'active')
constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
UNIQUE (introduction_id, participant_id)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, participant_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.participants(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: consent_decisions
purpose: One immutable accept/decline per invitation. This records what was actually approved, independent of later mail outcomes.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: invitation_id
columns.meaning: One winning decision; conflicting later responses cannot overwrite it.

columns.name: context_version_id
columns.meaning: Exact frozen context recipient decided on.

columns.name: consent_copy_version
columns.meaning: Version of disclosure displayed when deciding.

columns.name: consent_copy_snapshot
columns.meaning: Exact disclosure text, for historical reconstruction.

columns.name: request_id
columns.meaning: Server correlation ID; not the invitation token.

columns.name: applied_at
columns.meaning: When prerequisites were confirmed and transition applied; deferred for send-outcome reconciliation.

constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, invitation_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.invitations(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: decision_notes
purpose: Optional decline notes, private to the sender. Append revisions separately from immutable consent and from generic activity summaries.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: decision_id
columns.meaning: Must reference a decline, enforced by service.

columns.name: note
columns.meaning: Plain text, maximum 2000 Unicode characters; no automatic onward sharing.

constraints: UNIQUE (decision_id, revision)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, decision_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.consent_decisions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: generation_runs
purpose: Durable generation queue and provenance for each of the three parallel LLM calls. A retry/fallback has a new run ID; retain failed and superseded runs.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: context_version_id
columns.meaning: Immutable input context; shared by the initial three runs.

columns.name: base_message_version_id
columns.meaning: Version this run may replace, null on first generation.

columns.name: status
columns.meaning: queued, streaming, completed, failed, cancelled, superseded.

columns.name: prompt_sha256
columns.meaning: Hash of exact system prompt asset.

columns.name: input_snapshot
columns.meaning: Exact permitted facts and WHY passed to this run; owner-private.

columns.name: input_sha256
columns.meaning: Hash of sanitized model input, excluding execution order and private addresses; used for relevant-context staleness checks.

columns.name: settings
columns.meaning: Temperature, reasoning, token budget, timeout, provider policy and prompt asset snapshot/reference.

columns.name: partial_body
columns.meaning: Latest persisted coalesced stream output; not reviewable yet.

columns.name: usage
columns.meaning: Input/output/reasoning tokens and cost if reported; unknown remains null/absent.

columns.name: error_code
columns.meaning: Safe machine error; no raw tokens or sensitive request dumps.

columns.name: lease_token
columns.meaning: Fencing identity checked on every partial, heartbeat and completion; expired runs are failed and retried with a new run ID.

indexes: CREATE INDEX generation_runs_due_idx ON warm_intros.generation_runs(next_attempt_at, id) WHERE status = 'queued'
CREATE INDEX generation_runs_lease_idx ON warm_intros.generation_runs(lease_until, id) WHERE status = 'streaming'
constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
UNIQUE (message_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
post_create_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (message_id, parent_run_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.generation_runs(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (message_id, base_message_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.message_versions(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: stream_events
purpose: Replayable SSE transport. Short-lived chunks can be compacted after completion because final versions and run provenance remain; history is not dependent on chunks.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: seq
columns.meaning: Allocate under introduction row lock in the same commit as run partial text; prevents commit-order gaps.

columns.name: message_id
columns.meaning: Composer routing identity, not column position.

columns.name: kind
columns.meaning: snapshot, draft.started, draft.delta, draft.completed, draft.failed, draft.superseded, generation.completed.

columns.name: payload
columns.meaning: Typed event payload, no chain-of-thought or provider secrets.

constraints: PRIMARY KEY (introduction_id, seq)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, run_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.generation_runs(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
post_create_constraints: FOREIGN KEY (message_id, run_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.generation_runs(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: mail_deliveries
purpose: Durable outbox and one logical message send. The approved text, envelope, rendered HTML/text, and provider result remain inspectable even when retries occur.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: logical_key
columns.meaning: Deterministic send identity reused on all transport retries.

columns.name: state
columns.meaning: queued, sending, provider_accepted, retryable_failed, permanent_failed, unknown, suppressed.

columns.name: template_name
columns.meaning: First request, second request, final, or neutral closure.

columns.name: rendered_snapshot
columns.meaning: Envelope, HTML and plain text with capability URL redacted in owner/history read models; exact text preserved separately in ciphertext.

columns.name: payload_ciphertext
columns.meaning: Exact provider request, including capability URL; populated in the same transaction that freezes the payload and required (non-null) before the first attempt reserves dispatch. Encrypted at rest.

columns.name: encryption_key_version
columns.meaning: Key version for decrypting exact payload.

columns.name: payload_sha256
columns.meaning: Hash of complete canonical provider request; populated at payload freeze, stable on every retry.

columns.name: provider_email_id
columns.meaning: Resend ID; durable confirmation beyond its idempotency window.

columns.name: delivery_facts
columns.meaning: Provider delivery/bounce/complaint evidence with actual recipient scope; unidentified recipient outcomes stay unknown.

columns.name: attempt_count
columns.meaning: Cached count; attempt rows are the full record.

columns.name: lease_token
columns.meaning: Fencing identity; late worker completion cannot override a newer owner.

columns.name: first_attempt_at
columns.meaning: Start of provider idempotency safety window.

indexes: CREATE INDEX mail_deliveries_due_idx ON warm_intros.mail_deliveries(next_attempt_at, id) WHERE state IN ('queued', 'retryable_failed')
CREATE INDEX mail_deliveries_lease_idx ON warm_intros.mail_deliveries(lease_until, id) WHERE state = 'sending'
constraints: UNIQUE (introduction_id, id)
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (message_id, message_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.message_versions(message_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, invitation_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.invitations(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: delivery_attempts
purpose: Append-only record of every actual Resend API attempt. Attempts are not new logical emails.

columns.name: delivery_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.mail_deliveries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: lease_token
columns.meaning: Worker ownership used for this attempt.

columns.name: finished_at
columns.meaning: Null if process died; sweeper reconciles.

constraints: UNIQUE (delivery_id, attempt_number)

name: events
purpose: Permanent introduction timeline, separate from short-lived streaming chunks. Append in the same transaction as the state change.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.rule: NOT NULL REFERENCES warm_intros.introductions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: event_type
columns.meaning: Canonical event name; the V1 vocabulary is defined in the sequence-state section below.

columns.name: actor_user_id
columns.rule: REFERENCES users.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: metadata
columns.meaning: Structured safe facts, version IDs and stage changes; no token, full note or raw draft body.

indexes: CREATE INDEX events_intro_timeline_idx ON warm_intros.events(introduction_id, occurred_at, id)
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, participant_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.participants(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, message_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.messages(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, delivery_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.mail_deliveries(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (introduction_id, context_version_id) REFERENCES warm_intros.context_versions(introduction_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: provider_events
purpose: Durable verified webhook inbox, including unmatched events arriving before the send receipt.

columns.name: provider_event_id
columns.meaning: Provider webhook delivery/event identity, used for deduplication.

columns.name: provider_email_id
columns.meaning: Correlates to logical delivery when available.

columns.name: payload
columns.meaning: Verified minimal event data, recipient details restricted to authorized operators.

indexes: CREATE INDEX provider_events_unmatched_idx ON warm_intros.provider_events(received_at, id) WHERE status IN ('pending', 'unmatched', 'failed')

name: mutation_receipts
purpose: Durable request idempotency for create, save, review, start, decisions, notes, archive and cancel. Store no bearer token in the scope.

columns.name: scope_id
columns.meaning: Verified owner user ID or resolved invitation ID.

columns.name: request_sha256
columns.meaning: Canonical body hash; changed replay is conflict.

columns.name: introduction_id
columns.meaning: Committed introduction for this mutation; populated for every successful introduction-scoped operation. Nullable only so a create receipt can be inserted before the root row exists within the same transaction.

columns.name: response_snapshot
columns.meaning: Bounded result/receipt, no token or stale unrestricted source data.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Commit time; same transaction as operation.

constraints: UNIQUE (scope_type, scope_id, operation, idempotency_key)
